labels.label: bzprop:c1s3p2_fibre_produit

hypotheses.note: global triviality for paracompact Hausdorff B_i (exists_prodBase_homeomorph); the free action with orbits = fibres for any cones

findings: Proof of Prop. 2 (l.750–755, p. 244, confirmed on the scan): « le sous-groupe de R^{+p} formé des systèmes de p nombres réels positifs dont le produit est égal à 1. Un élément de ce sous-groupe définit un automorphisme de la structure conique affine du produit » is FALSE when the factors' dimensions differ: in product cone charts (λ_i) acts as the block homothety diag(λ_i), of determinant ∏ λ_i^{n_i}, which lies in GU(Σ n_i) iff ∏ λ_i^{n_i} = 1. Formal: not_isGXMorphism_blockHom_of_ne (p = 2, dims a+1 ≠ b+1: (2, 1/2) has product 1 and is not conical) and det_eq_one_of_isGXMorphism_blockHom. The proposition itself is TRUE: the corrected lift is ∏ λ_i^{n_i} = 1 (torusPair), equivalently every element of R^{+p} descends to a projective automorphism of the base. The printed lift is right when all B_i have the same dimension.
